Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  19.10.2023 ABA No.933 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

This Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 120B, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in connection with the Case Crime No.453 of 2023, registered at police station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.

2. Heard Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. M.K. Chand, learned A.G.A.
for the State.
3. Learned A.G.A. for the State submits on instructions that no evidence has yet been found in the investigation against the applicant- Shamshad Ali.
He has sought 15 days' time to get instructions regarding outcome of the investigation.

4. List on 10.11.2023 along with ABA No.764 of 2023 for hearing on Anticipatory Bail Application.
5.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, applicant-Shamshad Ali is directed to be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail, in the event of his arrest, on furnishing his personal bond of Rs.30,000/-
and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, with the following conditions :-
i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available at the time of interrogation by the Investigating Agency as and when required;
ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 19.10.2023
